function.name: mqtt_publish
function.description: Publish a message payload to a specified MQTT broker topic.

topic.description: Target MQTT topic path, e.g. sensors/temperature.

payload.description: Message payload string or serialized JSON.

qos.description: Quality of Service level (0=at most once, 1=at least once, 2=exactly once).

retain.description: Whether the message should be retained by the broker.

function.name: gpio_set
function.description: Configure pin direction and set digital output level on a GPIO pin.

state.description: Logic level to drive on the pin.

mode.description: Pin direction and pull resistor configuration.

function.name: set_interrupt
function.description: Register a hardware interrupt trigger and debounce threshold on a GPIO pin.

pin.description: GPIO pin index monitored for edge transitions.

trigger.description: Electrical condition that triggers the interrupt.

debounce_ms.description: Debounce period in milliseconds to filter mechanical noise.

callback.description: Identifier of the callback routine executed upon trigger.

function.name: set_telemetry_threshold
function.description: Configure alert boundaries and notification channels for an edge sensor metric.

sensor_id.description: Unique identifier of the physical or virtual sensor.

min_value.description: Lower safety threshold; values below trigger an underflow alert.

max_value.description: Upper safety threshold; values above trigger an overflow alert.

function.name: ble_scan
function.description: Perform a Bluetooth Low Energy discovery scan for nearby advertising peripherals.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of active or passive scanning in seconds.

service_uuids.description: Optional list of 16-bit or 128-bit service UUID filters.

rssi_threshold.description: Minimum received signal strength indicator in dBm, e.g. -85.

active.description: True for active scanning (request scan response packets), false for passive.

function.name: camera_capture
function.description: Trigger onboard image capture with configured optical and encoding parameters.

flash.description: Whether to fire auxiliary LED illumination during exposure.

exposure_comp.description: Exposure compensation value in EV stops (-2.0 to +2.0).

function.name: get_battery_status
function.description: Query onboard battery fuel gauge state of charge, voltage, and health metrics.

include_cells.description: Return per-cell voltages for multi-cell pack telemetry.

include_temperature.description: Return thermistor temperature readings in Celsius.

function.name: set_thermal_throttle
function.description: Set thermal management policy, temperature limits, and active cooling parameters.

max_temp_celsius.description: Junction temperature trip point that initiates clock downscaling.

fan_speed_pct.description: Manual fan duty cycle percentage (0 to 100).

function.name: check_ota_update
function.description: Query OTA distribution endpoint for available firmware packages and verify manifest integrity.

check_signature.description: Validate cryptographic ECDSA signature before reporting update readiness.

timeout_seconds.description: Network timeout waiting for update server manifest.

function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Schedule a hardware RTC alarm or watchdog wakeup timer event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp or cron expression for scheduled alarm.

message.description: Diagnostic or alarm notification message string.

severity.description: Severity level of the scheduled wakeup.

repeat_daily.description: Whether alarm auto-rearms every 24 hours at the target hour/minute.

function.name: configure_wifi
function.description: Provision Wi-Fi station interface credentials and IP addressing mode.

hidden.description: Whether the target network suppresses broadcast beacon frames.

function.name: upload_logs
function.description: Compress and upload system diagnostic circular buffer logs to remote storage.

server_url.description: Destination HTTPS endpoint or object store URL.

log_level.description: Minimum severity cutoff for uploaded log entries.

since_hours.description: Time window relative to present in hours to extract.
